purpose: Valid selection of the spectral contrast parameter from a finite library on the same observations
source_records: joint_analog.json exact_statistics, unchanged; no additional measurements
assumptions: Fixed library and quotas; independent stationary acquisitions or the declared bounded conditional-mean contract; same bounded memoryless noninvasive detector; ordinary even-variable time reversal
scope: The familywise method pays its selection penalty. No universal power advantage over a correctly prespecified contrast is claimed. Monte Carlo comparisons of different methods do not make their maximum a covered certificate.
